description: Reads the plan stored by set_plan. Local only: no Suunto call, writes nothing. Without `date`: the plan, currentPhase, todaySession (with its guide spec) and next7Days (the 7 days AFTER today; null session = rest day). With `date`: that day's phase and session. No plan: plan null. A damaged plan file is an error naming the file. Pushes nothing: pass a session's `guide` to push_strength_guide or push_week_plan.

date.description: One day to look up, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the whole plan.

name: get_plan
title: Get the training plan (today and the next 7 days)
